jobs.title: Corporate Development Manager - 12month FTC
jobs.description:
Who we’re looking for

We are seeking a proactive and commercially minded Corporate Development Manager to join our Corporate Development team. This role will play a key part in shaping and delivering Schroders’ strategic growth agenda, supporting the identification, evaluation, and execution of M&A, strategic partnerships, investments, and broader corporate initiatives.

About Us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

The base

We moved into our new HQ in the City of London in 2018. We’re close to our clients, in the heart of the UK’s financial centre and we have everything we need to work flexibly.

What you'll do

The Corporate Development Manager will take ownership of defined workstreams across transactions and strategic projects, partnering closely with senior stakeholders across Schroders and coordinating internal and external advisers. The role requires strong analytical capability, sound judgement, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Transaction execution & strategic delivery

-
Lead and deliver discrete workstreams across corporate development activity, including M&A, partnerships, and strategic investments, from initial assessment through execution to completion.

-
Develop and evaluate strategic business cases, including target/partner screening, commercial assessment, and risk considerations.

-
Manage transaction processes and workplans, ensuring appropriate governance, pace, and quality of outputs and engaging / negotiating with counterparties.

-
Build, review, and interpret financial models, valuation analyses, and scenario assessments, providing clear insights and recommendations to senior decision makers.

-
Lead elements of financial, commercial, and operational due diligence, coordinating inputs across Finance, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, and other relevant teams.

-
Synthesise diligence findings into clear implications, issues logs, and decision points.

-
Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders across business units and functions to drive progress and resolve blockers.

-
Coordinate external advisers (e.g., investment banks, legal counsel, consultants, and accounting firms), ensuring effective briefing, deliverable quality, and cost awareness.

-
Produce high-quality materials for senior management forums, including investment papers, executive presentations, and Board/committee documentation.

-
Present analysis and recommendations clearly, tailoring content to the audience and highlighting key trade-offs and risks.

-
Maintain a view of relevant industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments to inform strategic priorities and pipeline generation.

-
Support development of a robust opportunity pipeline, including maintaining relevant trackers and databases.

-
Support planning and delivery of key post-deal activities, including integration planning, synergy tracking, and progress reporting (as applicable).

-
Embed disciplined project management practices across assigned initiatives.

-
Understanding of financial statements, valuation concepts, and M&A lifecycle.

-
Knowledge of asset management and broader financial services markets.

-
Experience working with governance processes (e.g., investment committees / Board reporting).

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

-
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

-
High attention to detail and professional integrity.

-
Strong organisational and time management abilities, with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks.

-
Collaborative and proactive approach, comfortable working in a team environment.

-
Relevant undergraduate degree (e.g., Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting or similar) or equivalent experience.

Financial analysis, valuation & diligence

-
Build, review, and interpret financial models, valuation analyses, and scenario assessments, providing clear insights and recommendations to senior decision makers.

-
Lead elements of financial, commercial, and operational due diligence, coordinating inputs across Finance, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, and other relevant teams.

-
Synthesise diligence findings into clear implications, issues logs, and decision points.

Stakeholder & adviser management

-
Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders across business units and functions to drive progress and resolve blockers.

-
Coordinate external advisers (e.g., investment banks, legal counsel, consultants, and accounting firms), ensuring effective briefing, deliverable quality, and cost awareness.

Executive communication & governance

-
Produce high-quality materials for senior management forums, including investment papers, executive presentations, and Board/committee documentation.

-
Present analysis and recommendations clearly, tailoring content to the audience and highlighting key trade-offs and risks.

Market intelligence & opportunity development

-
Maintain a view of relevant industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments to inform strategic priorities and pipeline generation.

-
Support development of a robust opportunity pipeline, including maintaining relevant trackers and databases.

Project management

-
Support planning and delivery of key post-deal activities, including integration planning, synergy tracking, and progress reporting (as applicable).

- Embed disciplined project management practices across assigned initiatives.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need

-
Understanding of financial statements, valuation concepts, and M&A lifecycle.

-
Knowledge of asset management and broader financial services markets.

-
Experience working with governance processes (e.g., investment committees / Board reporting).

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

-
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

-
High attention to detail and professional integrity.

-
Strong organisational and time management abilities, with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks.

-
Collaborative and proactive approach, comfortable working in a team environment.

-
Relevant undergraduate degree (e.g., Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting or similar) or equivalent experience.

We recognise potential, whoever you are

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

jobs.title: 2027 Business Transformation Placement Year Programme
jobs.description:
Job title: Placement Year

Department: Business Transformation

Salary: £37,000

Start date: Monday 14 June 2027

Location: City of London, London

About us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Programme overview:

Our 12-month Placement Programme begins on Monday 14 June 2027 and offers a unique opportunity to bridge your academic learning with real-world financial experience. As a Placement Year student at Schroders, you will play an active role in the team, contributing to live projects and supporting strategic objectives through research and insightful analysis.

Throughout the programme you will:

-
Take part in comprehensive introductory training to build your understanding of the business

-
Be assigned to a team where you will contribute to live projects and gain meaningful hands-on experience

-
Shadow experienced professionals and learn directly from leaders in the field

-
Have opportunities to network with colleagues and other interns and placement year students, helping you build connections for your future career

This placement year programme provides practical experience, professional development, and a strong foundation for a successful career in asset and wealth management. We believe that a talented, creative and diverse team is key to our long-term success, so if you're intellectually curious, eager to learn and ready to make a meaningful impact, this 12-month programme will give you the skills, experience and exposure to help launch your career in the asset and wealth management industry.

Who We're Looking For

-
An inquisitive individual with a genuine interest in investment management, change, and industry trends.

-
A self-starter who takes initiative, embraces new challenges, and is eager to get involved in a broad range of activities.

-
Someone with a growth mindset who is open to feedback, learns from experience, and continually seeks opportunities to develop.

-
A collaborative team player who builds trusted relationships and contributes positively to team success.

-
An adaptable and resilient individual who remains composed in changing environments and approaches challenges with a positive attitude.

Required Skills & Capabilities

-
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders.

-
Analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to solve problems, balance detail with the bigger picture, and apply innovative thinking to challenges.

-
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and deliver high-quality work.

-
Proactive and adaptable approach, demonstrating resilience, accountability, and a willingness to take ownership of tasks and outcomes.

-
Curiosity and a genuine interest in investment management, industry developments, and emerging technologies, including AI.

The team

During the Business Transformation placement year programme, you will join one of the Transformation Office (GPTO) teams:

-
The Group Planning and Transformation Office (GPTO) consists of two separate but complementary disciplines: Business Transformation Solutions is a dynamic team of internal transformation consultants, specialising in providing Strategic Solutions to the entire Schroders Group, across a range of service lines, such as strategy and business model design, target operating models and shaping & support for large-scale complex transformation. Working closely with business stakeholders, we play a pivotal role in enabling and executing strategic transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company's objectives.

-
The Programme Management Office (PMO) oversees the organisation’s portfolio of projects and programmes ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and budgets to enable maximum value delivery. Their primary focus is setting the policy and structured process for prioritising initiatives, enabling effective resource allocation, monitoring progress against key milestones, managing budgets and key risks and providing governance frameworks to support decision-making. Additionally, they give Senior Leadership visibility over project and programme performance, enabling more informed and prompt responses to changing business needs.

What you will do

During your placement year, you will be assigned to a live project in the role of either Junior Consultant or Enterprise Portfolio Management Support. Depending on your placement year area, your experience may include:

-
Junior Consultant : Gain exposure to supporting the design and delivery of successful transformation whilst building knowledge of the business, its strategy and culture.

-
Enterprise Portfolio Management Support: Collaborate with portfolio managers, project teams and business stakeholders to gain exposure to how change initiatives are governed and tracked across the organization. Support portfolio planning, reporting and governance activities by assisting with data analysis, documentation and stakeholder communications. Help maintain portfolio information, monitor progress against key milestones, and contribute to regular review and decision-making forums.

Throughout your placement year, you’ll receive support and feedback from experienced colleagues to help you learn and develop key professional skills.

Knowledge, experience and qualifications we’re looking for:

-
When the placement year commences, you will have completed your second year of studies and will be on track to graduate with a degree (or equivalent) in 2029

-
We welcome applications from all degree subjects

-
Please note that we do not accept applications from students in their final year who intend to undertake further study (e.g. a Master's degree) before entering employment.

-
A good working knowledge of document production software, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

-
The ability to understand our target audiences

No prior Change or Investment Management experience is needed. We just need you to bring your drive, passion and enthusiasm to make the most of the opportunity, to start building your career.

Benefits of joining us :

When you join our placement year programme at Schroders, you will benefit from a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities, including:

-
Comprehensive training:

Access immersive training sessions focused on building industry knowledge, technical expertise, and essential soft skills to help you adapt quickly and make a meaningful impact

-
Senior networking opportunities:

Attend “Coffee Hours” led by senior leaders, providing opportunities to connect and grow your professional network

-
Buddy system:

Be paired with a dedicated graduate buddy who will guide and support your integration into the team and wider business

-
Potential for future opportunities:

The chance to secure a place on a 2029 Schroders Graduate Programme, subject to performance feedback

-
End-of-programme event:

Celebrate your achievements alongside other placement year students, interns and line managers at a dedicated event at Schroders HQ

-
On-site facilities:

Enjoy the convenience of an on-site staff restaurant and complimentary use of our on-site gym

Use of a private GP service

By joining us, you will be part of an inclusive environment where your learning, wellbeing, and professional growth are a priority.

Recruitment process:

-
Online application form

-
Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment

-
Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment

-
Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview

-
Assessment centre

Candidates must be available to start the placement year programme on Monday 14 June 2027 and commit to the full duration of the 12-month programme.

We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

投资分析师 ( 北京 )

关于施罗德

施罗德是一家全球投资管理机构，提供主动资产管理、财富管理及投资解决方案。我们致力于通过主动管理，为客户创造卓越的投资回报。我们的客户群体广泛，包括养老金计划、保险公司、主权财富基金、捐赠基金、基金会、高净值人士及家族办公室；同时，我们还通过与分销机构、财务顾问及线上平台合作，为终端客户提供服务。

施罗德创立于 1804 年，目前在全球 36 个地区拥有约 5,500 名员工。施罗德的成功得益于其多元化的业务模式，业务覆盖不同的资产类别、客户类型和地域市场。

工作概要：

您将加入施罗德中国投资团队。该岗位主要包括：

- 履行尽职调查和投资执行工作，同时进行投资组合分析、监控及深入的行业研究；

- 与团队紧密合作，对投资机会进行分析、评估，并提出投资建议；

- 支持业务拓展及投资者关系相关活动。

主要职责 ：

- 在资深团队成员的指导下，通过案头调研及实地走访，完成可靠、基于事实的研究；

- 作为前端分析的数据负责人，协助推动投资决策流程；

- 成为投后管理实践中的关键团队成员。

任职要求：

1. 具备 3 年以上私募股权投资基金、投资银行或顶级咨询公司相关工作经验。

2. 扎实的   财务建模、估值分析、尽职调查及投资分析能力。

3. 优秀的分析能力、沟通表达能力和学习能力，具备较强的成长潜力。

4. 具备团队合作精神，能够在快节奏、高压力环境下高效工作。

5. 具备流利的中英文书面及口头沟通能力。

无论您是谁，我们都重视您的潜力

我们的使命是通过主动管理，为客户创造卓越的投资回报。我们相信，多元化的观点与包容的文化有助于我们作出更明智的决策，并为客户实现更佳成果。因此，推动包容性是我们的战略重点之一，施罗德也是一家倡导平等机会的雇主。无论您的年龄、残障状况、性别认同、宗教信仰、性取向、社会经济背景或任何其他受法律保护的特征如何，我们都欢迎您加入。

我们会为所有岗位考虑灵活的工作安排，并提供合理便利，以支持求职者及员工，包括神经多样性人士、残障人士，以及有身体或心理健康需求的人士。如需了解更多信息，请参阅我们的常见问题。

jobs.title: Investment Product Analyst, Asia ex Japan Equities
jobs.description:
About Us
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.
Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
Team Overview
The Asian ex Japan Equities team at Schroders is dedicated to delivering long-term and sustainable investment performance for a diverse range of clients. Based across key financial hubs in the Asia-Pacific region, our team combines deep local expertise with a disciplined global perspective.
We employ a rigorous, research-driven investment approach, leveraging both quantitative and qualitative analysis. Our investment process emphasises collaboration, integrity, and a commitment to responsible investing, integrated with Schroders’ robust ESG framework.
The team works closely with colleagues across the organisation—including portfolio managers, research analysts, and client-focused professionals—to provide insightful market analysis and support innovative investment solutions.
Overview of Role
As part of the Asian Equity team, the Investment Product Analyst role is based in Singapore. The role will partner closely with fund managers and act as a bridge between our Asian Equities Investment team and Client Group, proactively engaging with client teams and other internal and external stakeholders to provide product expertise across the range of Asian Equity strategies managed by the desk. The position is embedded within the Asian Equity Team,   and is a regular participant in investment desk meetings, portfolio review sessions, and risk discussions, contributing analysis and insights that support informed investment decision-making of investors. The role will also play an important part in supporting the investment desk through portfolio analytics, performance analysis, and the generation of portfolio and research insights to facilitate risk and governance discussions with fund managers and research analysts.
Job responsibilities include preparing performance and risk analytics for regular portfolio discussions, developing product materials and investment commentaries for client engagement, and tracking market trends and peer performance. This role will also partner with Investors and Client Group on business development opportunities and will involve client-facing activities and presentations. In addition, the role will assist with account management for local and international clients whose equity accounts are managed by our investors in Hong Kong and Singapore, with the goal of delivering a positive client experience and supporting the longevity and profitability of client accounts and mandates.
The successful candidate will be someone willing to seize opportunities to help grow the Schroders Asian Equities business in an evolving environment.
Key Responsibilities
Investment & Portfolio Analytics Support
- Provide analytics support to the investment desk and help drive informed risk-taking by fund managers through enhanced portfolio analytics, performance analysis, and research insight.
- Generate portfolio and research insights to support investment, risk, and governance discussions with fund managers and research analysts, helping to inform portfolio positioning and decision-making.
- Prepare concise information packs and analysis for fund manager strategy meetings to facilitate idea generation and information exchange across the investment desk.
- Provide bespoke analysis and develop tools, dashboards, and reports that offer more holistic views of portfolios and strategies, regular investment insight, monitoring and decision support.
- Prepare analysis and portfolio insight for regular investment meetings, collaborate with the risk and analytics team to conduct strategy deep dives for selected strategies, helping fund managers understand key performance drivers and identify potential areas of concentration risk in portfolios.

- Provide top-down, risk, and style perspectives to help fund managers understand the combined impact of bottom-up investment decisions on overall strategy outcomes and portfolio risk.
- Assist in implementing investment desk and research initiatives that improve idea generation, information sharing, and research efficiency across the Asian Equities platform.
- Support the rollout and embedding of investment research and workflow tools across the Asian Equities desk, ensuring desk requirements are represented and disruption to day-to-day investment activity is minimised.
- Translate portfolio positioning, investment decisions, and performance outcomes into client ‑ facing materials, databases and general information on the Asian Equities product suite.
- Ensure all Asian Equities product presentations and fund updates are produced with high quality for distribution to sales channels.
- Prepare investment reports and support  discussions that explain  investment rationale, portfolio changes, performance and market developments, and act as a conduit for other internal subject matter experts where relevant.
- Collect and analyse comparative advantages among major peers and determine product niche as part of competitor analysis.
- Work closely with internal stakeholders on legal, compliance and operational aspects of funds and client portfolios - this includes coordination on matters pertaining to investment management agreements, investigation and follow-up on trade compliance matters, client instructions on funding and withdrawals.
- Ensure RFPs are completed with the highest standards possible and tailored to clients’ needs
- Embrace a technical approach to client service and reporting, with a focus on providing of high quality, thoughtful advice and service.

Product & Client Support
Equities Business Management and Development
- Participate in formulating overall business strategy including market landscape, competitor analysis, potential growth opportunities and developing actionable plans for the Asian Equities product suite.
- Streamline existing work processes and establish best practices for the Asian Equities platform in Asia.
- Work closely with the entire Public Equities platform to contribute to the business growth of the business within Asia.
- Assist with Schroders client events and new business pitches with Investment Directors, portfolio managers, client group representatives and stakeholders, and where required, in client reviews and conference calls with clients and prospects.
- Fronting and presenting to select client audiences directly to deliver investment narratives and messages for Asian equity strategies.

Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g. CFA or equivalent) are advantageous
- 5 to 7 years of relevant experience within the asset management industry, preferably with a focus on Asian equities
- Strong understanding of public equities investment strategies, products, and the broader Asian (ex Japan) markets
- Demonstrable experience in product management, product development, investment analysis, or similar roles within asset management
- Proven ability to clearly articulate investment strategies, processes, and performance to a variety of internal and external stakeholders
- Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare compelling client materials and reports
- Effective project management and organisational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
- Collaborative and proactive team player, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Fluency in English; additional Asian languages are advantageous

We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are
Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

jobs.title: Implementation Portfolio Manager, Asian Equities
jobs.description:
Job Title: Implementation Portfolio Manager (Asian Equities)
About Us
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
Job Summary:
We aim to successfully assist in the management and implementation of a portfolio’s investment strategy.

Implementation Portfolio Managers take responsibility for implementation of investment decisions and trades, working closely with Head of Portfolio Implementation and Investment Teams to design and propose the investment implementation and pre-trade compliance monitoring process.  In some teams they are also responsible for overseeing cash management, and corporate actions.

An Implementation Portfolio Manager’s main stakeholder is the Investment team; however as a senior team member he/ she is also expected to be able to manage and navigate more complex queries by representing the Investment Team in providing the support link between Investment Product, Operations & Client Group teams.  A good Implementation Portfolio Manager has to be able to meet the following criteria.
1.    At least 7 years in portfolio implementation relevant experience
2.    Have the support and trust of Investment colleagues when conducting the day-to-day as well as any ad-hoc investment implementation
3.    Have good knowledge of operational processes, business and market requirements.
4.    Have a good understanding of guidelines and regulations of mandates and funds managed by the investment desk
5.    Possess strong knowledge of regulations and execution processes for all markets included in desk strategies.
6.    Well versed in the Group’s policies and processes, including for e.g. the Risk Event Reporting procedures
7.    Have sufficient proficiency in Mandarin and written Chinese to review and interpret Chinese-language documentation and regulatory requirements
Key Responsibilities:
Key Activities
•    Designing and proposing procedures for implementation, pre-trade compliance monitoring and portfolio management
•    Trade authorisation (for Time Deposit and Unit Trust Only)
•    Day to day Portfolio oversight
•    Cash management & hedging
•    Transition management activities and fund restructuring
•    Risk Management using derivatives
•    Drift management of portfolio positions
•    Liquidity Monitoring
•    Coordinate Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) with Dealing team
•    Delivery of on-desk training (systems and processes)
Key Behaviours For Success
•    Attention to detail – granular, detail-oriented with strong mathematical and technical skills
•    Strong time management -  able to prioritise effectively and multi-task
•    Team player & relationship building –  establish strong connections and work collaboratively within the Implementation team, as well as with Fund Managers, Investment Product, Dealers, Portfolio Compliance, Performance, Ops & Fund Services teams
•    Good judgement - ability to work in a fast-paced environment and under pressure, able to exercise good judgement
•    Reliable - Sense of urgency, yet calm under pressure, trustworthy, disciplined, professional
•    Good communicator – clear, transparent, detailed, accessible and empathetic
•    Credible – Good understanding of and interest in markets and instruments (inclusive of Derivatives)
•     Prompt and Responsive – Pro-active and responds to calls/emails promptly

What an Implementation Portfolio Manager does not do
There are several activities which an Implementation Portfolio Manager will not be expected to do:
•    Make investment decisions
•    Authorise security trades
•    Execute trades
Escalation
Escalation of queries surrounding performance of Implementation Portfolio Manager activities should be directed to the Head of Portfolio Implementation (Asset Class).

Risk Event Procedure should be followed for notification of all Risk Events
We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are
Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst, Infrastructure Debt
jobs.description:
Who we’re looking for

The team aims to enable business growth, support business as usual, make operating model improvements, manage risk and simplify business processes.

What you’ll do

- Own daily PCF / basket file oversight (generation, validation, timeliness, and distribution/publishing per operating model).

- Troubleshoot PCF and pricing-related breaks (holdings vs model, identifiers, quantities/rounding tolerances, cash component variances, FX/pricing staleness, corporate actions impacts).

- Provide operational coverage of the Active ETF lifecycle, coordinating end-to-end exception resolution across Trading, PM, Ops, Tech, Data and the fund administrator.

- Support primary market operational touchpoints (create/redeem-related readiness, cut-offs, and escalations) in line with defined responsibilities.

- Liaise with the Fund Administrator / ETF servicing agent to ensure accurate deliverables, timely resolutions, and clear ownership of actions.

- Execute and enhance key operational controls (tolerance checks, sign-offs, evidencing, reconciliation/validation checks) to ensure auditability.

- Lead structured incident management (logging, triage, escalation, communications, root-cause analysis, and preventative actions).

- Contribute to service provider governance (KPIs, incident trends, SLA adherence, service reviews, and remediation tracking).

- Support change delivery and UAT for launches, enhancements, and vendor/platform releases, including test planning and regression coverage for PCF/pricing dependencies.

- Drive continuous improvement/automation initiatives (e.g., variance analysis tools, dashboards, standardised runbooks) to reduce manual effort and recurring errors.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need

- Proven experience in Active ETF / ETF operations, middle office, fund operations, fund accounting, custody/trustee, or ETF servicing.

- Strong understanding of ETF operating models, including key dependencies between portfolio holdings, basket/PCF outputs, pricing/valuation inputs, and downstream servicing.

- Demonstrable hands-on capability in PCF / basket file analysis and troubleshooting, including constituent validation and cash component variance investigation (or closely related file-based operational diagnostics).

- Solid grasp of the trade lifecycle (trade capture, confirmations/matching where applicable, settlement readiness, fail management) and how exceptions propagate operational risk.

- Experience working directly with Fund Administrators / custodians / ETF service providers, including issue escalation, SLA tracking, and service governance routines.

- Proven ability to perform structured root-cause and implementing preventative controls.

- Strong analytical tooling skills: advanced Excel; SQL/data interrogation capability preferred (Python/automation skills desirable but not required).

- Experience working within an asset management firm within front or middle office environment.

- Good technical investment services platform knowledge and ability to bridge the communications between third party vendors, IT and the business.

- Good understanding of fund management business and end to end Order/Trade workflow

- Familiarity with broad range of investment products and instruments.

- Familiarity with the dealing lifecycle of Equity, Active ETF, Fixed Income and OTC derivatives instruments is preferred.

- Strong communication skills and experience to manage third party portfolio, order, execution management system.

- Good inter-personal and organisational skills.

- Ability to operate under pressure, multi-tasking and deliver to demanding deadlines.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications that will help

- Knowledge of BlackRock Aladdin Solution is essential

- Knowledge of Mutual Fund operational process including fund setup, engagement with transfer agencies, fund administrators, custodians is preferred

- Business knowledge of other Asset Management front / middle office systems, such as MSCI Barra, FactSet, Charles River, Bloomberg and Eikon

Able to work under pressure, on several critical priorities at once

Have the ability to quickly understand business issues, make good judgements and quick decisions

A critical thinker and problem solver
